name: B10-0290/2026 (PfE) – Political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Cuba's government for repression and a health crisis, and asks the European Commission to suspend the EU's cooperation agreement with Cuba. It also asks the Council to sanction senior Cuban officials, including Miguel Díaz-Canel, and asks the European Court of Auditors to check all EU money given to Cuba since 2016.

- The EU's cooperation agreement with Cuba would be suspended if the Commission acts.
- Sanctions would target senior Cuban officials; EU aid would be checked.
- The Commission, Council and Court of Auditors must now respond; nothing changes yet.
